text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Source-context concentration did not transfer to a new-gene sample

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #38434e

g.text: Exploratory positive and prospective negative shown together; same published functional reference, not independent studies

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #49545e

g.text: Bands: complete minimum–maximum across fixed draws, NOT confidence intervals. No arm or N selected after outcomes.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #38434e

g.text: DEVELOPMENT | 92 measured genes · 3,968 nonsyntenic pairs · consumed-reference exploratory result

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #38434e

g.text: PROSPECTIVE GENE TRANSFER | 128 sampled genes · 7,648 nonsyntenic pairs · no full-curve advantage

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #38434e

g.text: New-gene historical context: 26 active and 102 zero-context queries. Fixed query frame and absolute means retain all queries.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #49545e

g.text: O/E pools observed and query-matched expected sums. Zero-context queries add zero to both; the ratio is NOT coverage-adjusted.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #49545e

g.text: RA weights shared models by inverse observed degree in each full-gene arm. Absolute affinity may fall as O/E rises.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #49545e

g.text: New-gene ranks are within the sampled cohort, not genomewide top N or significance-defined positives. No fitness fit or new model is involved.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #49545e

g.text: Historical pan-cancer reference; no independent-study confirmation, calibrated biological accuracy, predictive benefit or automatic-pruning claim.
